answer.reason: Sharon has one pastoral fact under David and one event in Acts; the Song and Isaiah verses are figures or prophecy.

clauses.english: had King David's herds feeding on its plain
clauses.quote: over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite

clauses.english: saw its people turn to the Lord after Peter healed Aeneas
clauses.quote: all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord

doubts: SNG 1:17 does not concern Sharon and was left out.
SNG 2:1 (rose of Sharon) is a figure of speech, not an event.
ISA 33:9, ISA 35:2 and ISA 65:10 are prophetic images or promises, not events, so they were left out.
